name: Campus Cards
tagline: Place cards for the ten University of California campuses, one set at a time.
notice: Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
creator: tz2FjJhB1gb9Xc2qNB7QgFkdBZkGCCRMxdFw

sets.title: Set 01 · Santa Barbara
sets.subtitle: Goleta & Isla Vista, where the campus runs out of land

cards.title: Storke Tower
cards.flavor: The carillon tower at the middle of campus. You can find your way home by it.

cards.title: Campus Point
cards.flavor: The bluff tip where the campus meets the channel. Surf check, then class.

cards.title: Coal Oil Point
cards.flavor: Dunes and a slough at the west end of Isla Vista. Small shorebirds nest here; walk around them.

cards.title: The Lagoon
cards.flavor: A tidal lagoon the campus wraps around. Herons stand very still in it.

cards.title: Del Playa Sunset
cards.flavor: Every backyard on the ocean side ends at a cliff. Everyone faces west at the same time.

cards.title: The Islands
cards.flavor: On a clear day the Channel Islands sit on the horizon like they were painted there.

cards.title: Pardall Tunnel
cards.flavor: The bike tunnel between Isla Vista and campus. Ring your bell on the way in.

cards.title: The Roundabout
cards.flavor: Bike traffic circles. Counterclockwise, no stopping, trust the flow.

cards.title: Ten Thousand Bikes
cards.flavor: Racks outside every lecture hall at ten to the hour. Remember where you locked it.

cards.title: Goleta Pier
cards.flavor: A long wooden pier past the slough. Fishing lines, pelicans, a slow walk back.

cards.title: The Santa Ynez
cards.flavor: The mountains behind everything. They turn pink for about four minutes at dusk.

cards.title: Marine Layer
cards.flavor: Mornings start grey. By noon it burns off and the whole coast shows up.

sets.title: Set 02 · Berkeley
sets.subtitle: The East Bay, where the hills look straight out through the Golden Gate

cards.title: Sather Tower
cards.flavor: The campanile. The bells play at noon and you can hear them from half of town.

cards.title: Sather Gate
cards.flavor: The bronze gate on the old south edge of campus. Everyone walks through it eventually.

cards.title: The Bay from Above
cards.flavor: Climb the fire trails at sunset and the whole bay lines up, bridge and all.

cards.title: Sproul Steps
cards.flavor: The steps where people have been standing up to speak since 1964. Bring something to say.

cards.title: The Greek Theatre
cards.flavor: An open-air amphitheater in the eucalyptus. The stone seats stay warm after dark.

cards.title: Memorial Glade
cards.flavor: The big lawn in front of the library. Blankets, frisbees, one person actually studying.

cards.title: Strawberry Creek
cards.flavor: A creek runs right through campus under little footbridges. Stop and listen for it.

cards.title: Eucalyptus Grove
cards.flavor: Very tall trees on the west side of campus. The air smells like cough drops.

cards.title: Telegraph Avenue
cards.flavor: Records, tie-dye, vendor tables, a slice of pizza. Four blocks that never quite close.

cards.title: Downtown BART
cards.flavor: The train under Shattuck. Twenty-some minutes to the city, less if you run the stairs.

cards.title: Tilden Carousel
cards.flavor: Up in the park above the hills, an old carousel keeps going around.

cards.title: Fog at the Gate
cards.flavor: Late afternoon the fog pours in through the Golden Gate like it has somewhere to be.

sets.title: Set 03 · Davis
sets.subtitle: Davis, where the valley is flat enough to ride anywhere

cards.title: The Quad
cards.flavor: The big lawn in the middle of campus, under old shade trees. Bikes stream around it like water around a rock.

cards.title: The Arboretum
cards.flavor: A long, slow waterway lined with oaks. Walk it early and the geese have the place to themselves.

cards.title: Double-Decker Bus
cards.flavor: A red double-decker rolls down a shady Davis street. Ride up top and wave at the bikes.

cards.title: Farmers Market
cards.flavor: Saturday morning in the park: peaches, peppers, bread, a band, and everyone you know from class.

cards.title: Mondavi Center
cards.flavor: At dusk the big glass lobby glows like a lantern. Somebody inside is tuning up.

cards.title: Class Change
cards.flavor: The hour turns and the bike paths fill edge to edge. Signal, hold your line, keep pedaling.

cards.title: The Water Tower
cards.flavor: Tall and plain, it pokes up over the trees. Handy when you forget which way you parked your bike.

cards.title: The Dairy
cards.flavor: Out at the edge of campus the cows are up before class. You smell the barns before you see them.

cards.title: Tomato Harvest
cards.flavor: Late summer, the trucks roll past heaped red with tomatoes. The whole road smells like it.

cards.title: Orchard Bloom
cards.flavor: Late winter the orchards go white almost overnight, with mustard gold between the rows.

cards.title: Valley Sunset
cards.flavor: Nothing in the way for miles. The sky gets the whole show and the sun takes its time going down.

cards.title: Fog Ride
cards.flavor: Some winter mornings the fog sits down on the valley and stays. Ride slow and follow the path.

sets.title: Set 04 · Irvine
sets.subtitle: Orange County, where the campus is a ring drawn around a park

cards.title: Aldrich Park
cards.flavor: The park at the center of the ring. Every building faces it, so every walk crosses it.

cards.title: Langson Library
cards.flavor: A concrete library from the early campus, all deep windows and shade. The upper floors go very quiet.

cards.title: San Joaquin Marsh
cards.flavor: Ponds and cattails right next to campus. Herons stand in the shallows like they are waiting on something.

cards.title: Crystal Cove
cards.flavor: Old wooden beach cottages tucked under the bluff down the coast. The sun goes down right in front of them.

cards.title: The Back Bay
cards.flavor: A wide estuary between the bluffs, mud flats and marsh. Walk the loop at low tide and count egrets.

cards.title: Concrete Modern
cards.flavor: The first buildings are sculpted concrete with deep sunshades. At night they look like the future did once.

cards.title: Ring Mall
cards.flavor: The walkway that loops the park. Go the long way around and you still get where you meant to go.

cards.title: Eucalyptus Rows
cards.flavor: Long lines of windbreak trees left from ranch days. They creak a little when the afternoon wind comes up.

cards.title: Purple Sidewalks
cards.flavor: Late spring the jacarandas turn purple, and then the sidewalks under them turn purple too.

cards.title: The Bike Trails
cards.flavor: Trails slip under the big roads, so you can ride a long way before you ever wait for a light.

cards.title: The Open Hills
cards.flavor: Golden hills kept open at the edge of town. Early on, the marine layer fills the flats below you.

cards.title: Low Tide
cards.flavor: When the water pulls back: anemones, snails, a crab that saw you first. Look, then leave it be.

sets.title: Set 05 · Los Angeles
sets.subtitle: Westwood, red brick on a hill between the mountains and the ocean haze

cards.title: Royce Hall
cards.flavor: Two brick towers over the quad. Everyone takes the same photo from the lawn, and it is always worth it.

cards.title: Powell Library
cards.flavor: Royce’s partner across the quad. Step inside, look up at the ceiling, then find a seat.

cards.title: Janss Steps
cards.flavor: The long brick stairway up to the old heart of campus. Count them once, then never again.

cards.title: Inverted Fountain
cards.flavor: The water falls in instead of shooting up. Sit on the rim and listen to it tumble.

cards.title: Sculpture Garden
cards.flavor: A shady lawn on the north side of campus. Take the long way to class through it.

cards.title: Botanical Garden
cards.flavor: A green ravine tucked into a corner of campus. Tall trees, running water, instant quiet.

cards.title: Westwood Village
cards.flavor: The old movie palace tower glows over the village. A premiere some nights, a late show most others.

cards.title: Jacaranda Season
cards.flavor: In late spring the trees go purple, and so do the sidewalks, and so do your bike tires.

cards.title: Sunset Boulevard
cards.flavor: It bends along the north edge of campus. After dark the headlights trace every curve.

cards.title: Santa Ana Afternoon
cards.flavor: Some autumn days the wind blows in from the desert. Hot, dry, and the hills look close enough to touch.

cards.title: The View West
cards.flavor: From the top of the hill the sky goes gold to the west, where the ocean hides in the haze.

cards.title: The Arcades
cards.flavor: Brick arches between classes. The afternoon sun lays their shadows down the walkway.

sets.title: Set 06 · Merced
sets.subtitle: the east edge of the valley, where the grassland runs out to the Sierra

cards.title: Lake Yosemite
cards.flavor: The lake just past the edge of campus. Early in the morning it holds the whole sky.

cards.title: Vernal Pools
cards.flavor: Winter rain fills shallow pools in the grassland. In spring they bloom in rings, yellow and white.

cards.title: The Sierra, Clear Day
cards.flavor: After a winter storm the air clears and the snowy Sierra lines up along the east. Look while it lasts.

cards.title: Almond Bloom
cards.flavor: Late winter the orchards go white all at once. Petals blow across the road like a slow snow.

cards.title: Tule Fog
cards.flavor: Some winter mornings the valley disappears. A fence post, a pair of headlights, then nothing.

cards.title: Cattle on the Range
cards.flavor: Cattle graze the open rangeland near campus. They keep the grass short and rarely look up.

cards.title: Shade Walks
cards.flavor: New buildings, wide walkways, shade overhead. By afternoon you learn to walk from shadow to shadow.

cards.title: The Road In
cards.flavor: A long straight road out from town past fields and ditches. Then the campus shows up all at once.

cards.title: Merced River
cards.flavor: Cottonwoods, gravel bars, slow green water. The cool place to be when the valley heat sets in.

cards.title: Big Valley Sky
cards.flavor: Nothing out here to stop it. The sky runs all the way down to the fields.

cards.title: Toward Yosemite
cards.flavor: Head east and the road starts climbing into the foothills. The granite is somewhere up ahead.

cards.title: Valley Stars
cards.flavor: Out past the last streetlight it gets properly dark. The crickets keep going until morning.

sets.title: Set 07 · Riverside
sets.subtitle: Riverside & the Box Springs, where the old groves meet the hot dry hills

cards.title: The Bell Tower
cards.flavor: The carillon at the middle of campus. When it plays, the whole place slows down to listen.

cards.title: The Citrus Rows
cards.flavor: Row after row of citrus trees, sweet to sour, kept on campus like a living library.

cards.title: The Mission Inn
cards.flavor: A rambling old hotel downtown, all arches, bells and domes. At the holidays it glows.

cards.title: Box Springs
cards.flavor: Brown boulder hills right behind campus. Take water, go early, and watch the town come up.

cards.title: Botanic Gardens
cards.flavor: Paths wind up into the hills past cactus, agave and sage. Hummingbirds work the flowers.

cards.title: Mount Rubidoux
cards.flavor: A granite hill at the edge of downtown. People walk it at sunrise and catch their breath on top.

cards.title: Victoria Avenue
cards.flavor: A long old parkway lined with palms, running out past the groves. Best on a bike, early.

cards.title: Santa Ana Winds
cards.flavor: The dry wind comes down off the passes. The sky goes sharp blue and every palm leans one way.

cards.title: Inland Summer
cards.flavor: Afternoons get hot out here. Find a shade tree, a sprinkler, or the coolest room you know.

cards.title: The Packing House
cards.flavor: Oranges once left town in wooden crates, each one with a bright painted label on the end.

cards.title: The Parent Navel
cards.flavor: An old navel orange tree behind a little fence at a busy corner. A lot of groves trace back to it.

cards.title: Evening Freight
cards.flavor: Long freight trains roll through town at all hours. You can count the cars, or just wave.

sets.title: Set 08 · San Diego
sets.subtitle: La Jolla, where the mesa ends in sandstone and the Pacific does the rest

cards.title: Geisel Library
cards.flavor: Concrete and glass stacked wide at the top, up in the eucalyptus. The lights stay on late for finals.

cards.title: Scripps Pier
cards.flavor: A long research pier walking straight out into the Pacific. The pelicans treat it as theirs.

cards.title: Torrey Pines
cards.flavor: Wind-bent pines on crumbling sandstone bluffs. You hear the surf long before you see it.

cards.title: The Gliderport
cards.flavor: The sea breeze hits the cliffs and lifts straight up. Bright wings hang there like kites.

cards.title: La Jolla Cove
cards.flavor: Sea lions sprawled across the warm rocks, barking about nothing. You smell them first.

cards.title: Mesa Eucalyptus
cards.flavor: Tall pale trunks in long rows across the mesa. Bark peels off in ribbons underfoot.

cards.title: Tide Pools
cards.flavor: Low tide opens little windows in the rock. Anemones, a crab, a star. Look, do not touch.

cards.title: Black's Beach
cards.flavor: A long walk down below the cliffs. The surfers are already out, waiting on the next set.

cards.title: The Trolley
cards.flavor: The trolley glides along its raised track through campus. Downtown without a parking space.

cards.title: June Gloom
cards.flavor: The marine layer rolls in grey and soft and stays till noon. Bring a sweatshirt to the beach.

cards.title: Library Walk
cards.flavor: The long walk up the middle of campus, club tables on both sides, the library at the end.

cards.title: Sunset, La Jolla
cards.flavor: Everyone stops what they are doing to watch the sun go into the ocean. Some people clap.

sets.title: Set 09 · San Francisco
sets.subtitle: A hill in the fog above the park, and a newer campus down by the bay

cards.title: Parnassus Heights
cards.flavor: Buildings stacked up a steep hillside, with the big tower on the ridge above, half in the fog.

cards.title: Sutro Tower in Fog
cards.flavor: Some evenings only the top of the tower pokes out, like a ship sailing on the fog.

cards.title: Mission Bay
cards.flavor: The newer campus down by the water. Glass buildings, wide walks, and the bay right there.

cards.title: Mount Sutro Forest
cards.flavor: A eucalyptus forest right above campus. Trails, ferns, and fog dripping off the leaves.

cards.title: The N Judah
cards.flavor: The streetcar stops at the foot of the hill and keeps going all the way to the ocean.

cards.title: Night Shift Windows
cards.flavor: Late at night the windows stay lit on the hill. Someone is always awake, looking after someone.

cards.title: Inner Sunset
cards.flavor: Cafes, noodle shops and fog on Irving Street, just down the hill from campus.

cards.title: Golden Gate Park
cards.flavor: The park starts a few blocks down the hill. Big trees, quiet lakes, and room to think.

cards.title: Fog Rolling In
cards.flavor: Summer afternoons the fog climbs in from the ocean and swallows the houses one row at a time.

cards.title: Hillside Stairways
cards.flavor: Stairs instead of streets where the hill gets too steep. Gardens on both sides, a view at the top.

cards.title: Ocean Beach
cards.flavor: Ride the streetcar to the end of the line and there is the whole Pacific, cold and loud.

cards.title: Library Window
cards.flavor: Heads down in the reading room, while outside the window the fog moves over the treetops.

sets.title: Set 10 · Santa Cruz
sets.subtitle: a campus built inside a redwood forest, with the bay laid out below

cards.title: The Redwoods
cards.flavor: The campus is built inside a redwood forest. The buildings sit between the trunks like they asked first.

cards.title: The Great Meadow
cards.flavor: A long grass slope near the entrance. Walk up it, turn around, and the whole bay is waiting.

cards.title: Steamer Lane
cards.flavor: The point break below the little lighthouse. Lean on the cliff rail and count the sets.

cards.title: The Lime Kilns
cards.flavor: Old stone kilns tucked in the trees, left from the ranch days. Moss has taken over the work.

cards.title: The Quarry
cards.flavor: An old limestone quarry, now a place to gather. The pale rock walls hold the afternoon sun.

cards.title: The Boardwalk
cards.flavor: A seaside amusement park on the beach. The wooden coaster rattles and everyone screams on cue.

cards.title: The Old Barns
cards.flavor: Weathered ranch buildings by the entrance, from when this whole hill was a ranch.

cards.title: Ravine Bridges
cards.flavor: Ravines cut through campus, so the paths cross them on footbridges. Look down: ferns, then more ferns.

cards.title: The Farm
cards.flavor: Rows of vegetables and flowers on the lower slope. Someone is always kneeling in the dirt.

cards.title: Deer at Dawn
cards.flavor: Early morning, deer graze the meadow like they own it. Give them room and they barely look up.

cards.title: The Wharf
cards.flavor: A long wooden wharf out over the bay. Sea lions bark from the beams underneath.

cards.title: Redwood Fog
cards.flavor: Fog climbs the hill from the bay and settles in the trees. Everything goes quiet and damp.
